name: Transit direction indicator code
description: Code specifying the direction of transport.

values.name: Buyer to seller
values.description: Buyer to seller The transport from the buyer to the seller.

values.name: Seller to buyer
values.description: Seller to buyer The transport from the seller to the buyer.

values.name: Subcontractor to seller
values.description: Subcontractor to seller The transport from the subcontractor to the seller.

values.name: Seller to drop ship designated location
values.description: Seller to drop ship designated location The transport from the seller to the drop ship designated location.

values.name: Seller to freight forwarder
values.description: Seller to freight forwarder The transport from the seller to the freight forwarder.

values.name: Seller to subcontractor
values.description: Seller to subcontractor The transport from the seller to the subcontractor.

values.name: Mother vessel to lighter
values.description: Mother vessel to lighter Cargo is transferred from the main carriage or mother vessel to a lighter.

values.name: Lighter to mother vessel
values.description: Lighter to mother vessel Cargo is transferred from the lighter vessel to a main carriage or mother vessel.

values.name: Mutually defined
values.description: Mutually defined A code assigned within a code list to be used on an interim basis and as defined among trading partners until a precise code can be assigned to the code list.
